references.text: Here Uzziah is mentioned as the son of Kohath and brother to Amram (Aaron's father), confirming that Mishael and Elzaphan were Aaron's cousins.
Uzziah is mentioned as one of the sons of Kohath among the clans of the Levites.
Elzaphan, the son of Uzziah, is mentioned as the head of the clans of the Kohathites.
The context for why Mishael and Elzaphan had to carry away their relatives: Nadab and Abihu died after offering unauthorized fire before the Lord.
Priests were normally not to make themselves unclean by contact with a dead body, so Aaron and his surviving sons were not asked to carry away the dead.
Unclean persons, including those who had touched a dead body, were to be sent outside the camp so as not to defile the sanctuary.
Elzaphan is mentioned as the ancestor of a Levitical clan that later served in the temple.
